summary: Nâng từ parse cấu trúc lên hiểu ngữ nghĩa: semantic analyzer, rule simulator, reference extractor v2, impact analysis.

wps.name: PegaSemanticAnalyzer — Phân tích ngữ nghĩa rule (summary, intent, side effects, data flow)
PegaRuleSimulator — Mô phỏng thực thi rule offline (Activity, DataTransform, Flow, DecisionTable)
PegaReferenceExtractor 2.0 — 11 extraction strategies, cycle detection, dependency graph
PegaImpactAnalyzer — Risk assessment, scope determination, test suggestions, DOT graph

result: 48 semantic tests + 37 reference tests. Có thể analyze + simulate + extract dependencies cho mọi rule type.
